fields.verdict: race/ethnicity: not stated (equivalent to omitting basis)
fields.why: The article does not say how race was defined (the Table note only gives the Hispanic-ethnicity assumption); the brief allows either omitting basis or giving "not stated", so both records carry the same information.

brief_issues: Basis "not stated" and an omitted basis are interchangeable under the brief; normalizing them before comparing would remove this kind of disagreement.
